fullPassage:
I wake up to the sound of cheerful music. The curtains open, and sunlight fills my room.
"Good morning, Sumin. It's time to get up!"
"Hi, Luna!" I say to my AI friend.
I brush my teeth and check today's schedule on the smart mirror.
"How's the weather?"
"It's sunny today."
"Great. I can play soccer during lunch break."
"Good! You'll have fun with your friends!"
I enjoy a healthy breakfast with my family and walk to school.
In history class, Ms. Shin guides us on a virtual trip to Egypt. With our goggles on, we soon walk along the Nile River and enter a grand pyramid.
"Do you know about Pharaohs? They were the kings of ancient Egypt. You can see their lives in these wall paintings. The ancient Egyptians believed in life after death."
Exploring a new world in class is wonderful!
After lunch, I go outside to play soccer. I feel happy when my team wins!
"Sumin! That was a great goal!"
"Thanks, Minji. We did well together!"
We both smile and cheer for each other.
Nice work! You reached 70% of your exercise goal!
At home, I review my studies with Luna.
"I couldn't solve these three questions on the math test today. Can you explain them?"
"OK. I'll give you some tips and problems to practice."
"Thanks. I feel that I'm ready for the next test. By the way, I learned about Pharaohs and pyramids in history class. Can you recommend some video clips to watch? I want to learn more about Egyptian history."
"Sure. Here they are."
During dinner, I talk about my day with my family.
"How was your day?"
"It was fun. I think that my soccer skills are getting better."
After that, I take a walk with my dad.
I keep a diary before bed and go to sleep.
"Good night, Luna. Please play a hip-hop song at 7 a.m. tomorrow."
"OK. Sweet dreams!"

questions.passage: I wake up to the sound of (A)__________ music. The curtains open, and sunlight fills my room. I brush my teeth and check today's (B)__________ on the smart mirror. I enjoy a (C)__________ breakfast with my family and walk to school.
questions.stem: 빈칸 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: (A) 기분 좋은 음악 (B) 일정 (C) 건강한 아침 식사
det.analysis:
✅ ② cheerful — schedule — healthy: 원문 그대로
❌ ① cheerful — weather — healthy: (B) weather는 아침에 물어보는 내용이지 거울에서 확인하는 것이 아님
❌ ③ wonderful — schedule — grand: wonderful은 수업 감상, grand는 피라미드 수식어
❌ ④ sunny — mirror — cheerful: sunny는 날씨, mirror는 기구 이름
det.tip: cheerful(기분 좋은), schedule(일정), healthy(건강한) — 아침 루틴 핵심 단어

questions.passage: In history class, Ms. Shin guides us on a (A)__________ trip to Egypt. With our goggles on, we soon walk along the Nile River and enter a (B)__________ pyramid. Exploring a new world in class is (C)__________!
questions.stem: 빈칸 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ③ virtual — grand — wonderful: 원문 일치
❌ ① real — grand — wonderful: (A) real은 가상이 아닌 실제 여행
❌ ② virtual — ancient — cheerful: (B) ancient는 이집트를 수식, (C) cheerful은 음악 수식어
❌ ④ virtual — small — healthy: (B)(C) 원문과 불일치
det.tip: virtual(가상의), grand(웅장한), wonderful(멋진) — 역사 수업 장면

questions.passage: At home, I review my studies with Luna. I couldn't (A)__________ these three questions on the math test today. Can you (B)__________ them? I feel that I'm ready for the next test. Can you (C)__________ some video clips to watch?
questions.stem: 빈칸 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ④ solve — explain — recommend: 원문 일치
❌ ① explain — solve — review: 순서가 뒤바뀜
❌ ② solve — review — practice: (B) review는 복습, (C) practice는 연습
❌ ③ practice — recommend — solve: 모두 잘못된 위치

questions.passage: I wake up to the sound of cheerful music. The curtains open, and sunlight fills my room. I brush my teeth and check today's schedule on the smart mirror. "How's the weather?" "It's ①<u>sunny</u> today." "Great. I can play soccer during ②<u>lunch break</u>." I enjoy a ③<u>dangerous</u> breakfast with my family and ④<u>walk</u> to school.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중 문맥상 부적절한 것은?

det.korean: ③ dangerous(위험한) → healthy(건강한)가 적절. 가족과 함께 먹는 아침 식사이므로 '건강한'이 맞음
det.analysis:
✅ ③ dangerous: 원문은 healthy(건강한). '위험한 아침 식사'는 문맥에 맞지 않음
❌ ① sunny: 날씨 묘사로 적절
❌ ② lunch break: 점심시간에 축구한다는 내용과 일치
❌ ④ walk: 걸어서 등교 → 적절

questions.passage: In history class, Ms. Shin guides us on a virtual trip to Egypt. With our goggles on, we soon walk along the Nile River and enter a grand pyramid. "Do you know about Pharaohs? They were the kings of ①<u>ancient</u> Egypt. You can see their lives in these ②<u>wall paintings</u>. The ancient Egyptians ③<u>forgot</u> in life after death." Exploring a new world in class is ④<u>wonderful</u>!
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중 문맥상 부적절한 것은?

det.korean: ③ forgot(잊었다) → believed(믿었다)가 적절. 고대 이집트인은 사후 세계를 '믿었다'
det.analysis:
✅ ③ forgot: 원문은 believed(믿었다). '잊었다'는 문맥에 맞지 않음
❌ ① ancient: '고대' 이집트 → 적절
❌ ② wall paintings: '벽화' → 적절
❌ ④ wonderful: 수업에서 새로운 세계를 탐험하는 것이 '멋진' → 적절

questions.stem: 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중 문맥상 부적절한 것은?

det.korean: ④ schedule(일정) → diary(일기)가 적절. 잠자리에 들기 전 '일기'를 쓴다는 내용
det.analysis:
✅ ④ schedule: 원문은 diary(일기). 잠자기 전 '일정'을 유지한다는 것은 부적절
❌ ① solve: 문제를 '풀다' → 적절
❌ ② practice: '연습하다' → 적절
❌ ③ recommend: '추천하다' → 적절
det.tip: diary(일기) ↔ schedule(일정) — keep a diary(일기를 쓰다)

questions.passage: I wake up to the sound of cheerful music. The curtains open, and __________ fills my room. I brush my teeth and check today's schedule on the smart mirror. "How's the weather?" "It's sunny today." "Great. I can play soccer during lunch break."

det.analysis:

❌ ① moonlight: 아침이므로 달빛은 부적절
❌ ③ darkness: 커튼이 열렸는데 어둠은 모순
❌ ④ music: 음악은 이미 소리로 언급됨, 방을 '채우는' 것은 빛

questions.stem: 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ③ ancient: 파라오 = 고대 이집트의 왕 → 원문 일치
❌ ① modern: 현대와 파라오는 시대 불일치
❌ ② future: 미래 이집트는 문맥상 불가
❌ ④ nearby: '가까운'은 장소 형용사로 부적절
det.tip: ancient(고대의) — Pharaohs = kings of ancient Egypt

det.analysis:
✅ ① recommend: 영상을 추천해 달라는 요청 → 원문 일치
❌ ② record: 녹화하다 — Luna에게 녹화를 부탁하는 문맥 아님
❌ ③ remove: 제거하다 — 영상을 제거하는 상황 아님
❌ ④ repeat: 반복하다 — 영상 반복 요청이 아님

questions.passage: I wake up to the sound of <u>cheerful</u> music. The curtains open, and sunlight fills my room. I brush my teeth and check today's schedule on the smart mirror. I enjoy a healthy breakfast with my family and walk to school.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 cheerful의 의미와 가장 가까운 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ② happy: cheerful의 동의어 (즐거운)
❌ ① quiet: 조용한 → 반대 느낌
❌ ③ loud: 시끄러운 → 소리 크기이지 기분 아님
❌ ④ strange: 이상한 → 무관

questions.passage: In history class, Ms. Shin <u>guides</u> us on a virtual trip to Egypt. With our goggles on, we soon walk along the Nile River and enter a grand pyramid. Exploring a new world in class is wonderful!
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 guides의 의미와 가장 가까운 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ③ leads: guides의 동의어 (이끌다)
❌ ① stops: 멈추다 → 반대
❌ ② follows: 따라가다 → 방향 반대
❌ ④ watches: 지켜보다 → 안내하는 것이 아님

questions.passage: At home, I <u>review</u> my studies with Luna. "I couldn't solve these three questions on the math test today. Can you explain them?" "OK. I'll give you some tips and problems to practice."
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 review의 의미와 가장 가까운 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ① go over: review의 동의어 (다시 살펴보다)
❌ ② give up: 포기하다 → 반대
❌ ③ throw away: 버리다 → 무관
❌ ④ turn off: 끄다 → 무관

questions.passage: In history class, Ms. Shin guides us on a virtual trip to Egypt. With our goggles on, we soon walk along the Nile River and enter a <u>grand</u> pyramid. Exploring a new world in class is wonderful!
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 grand의 의미와 가장 먼 것은?

det.analysis:
❌ ③ tiny: 반의어 (아주 작은)
✅ ① large: 유사어 (큰)
✅ ② great: 유사어 (훌륭한)
✅ ④ huge: 유사어 (거대한)

questions.passage: "Do you know about Pharaohs? They were the kings of <u>ancient</u> Egypt. You can see their lives in these wall paintings. The ancient Egyptians believed in life after death." Exploring a new world in class is wonderful!
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 ancient의 의미와 가장 먼 것은?

det.analysis:
❌ ① modern: 반의어 (현대의)
✅ ② old: 유사어 (오래된)
✅ ③ historic: 유사어 (역사적인)
✅ ④ early: 유사어 (초기의)

questions.passage: After lunch, I go outside to play soccer. I feel happy when my team wins! "Sumin! That was a great <u>goal</u>!" We both smile and cheer for each other. Nice work! You reached 70% of your exercise <u>goal</u>!
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 두 goal의 의미를 바르게 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: 첫 번째 goal = 골(축구 득점), 두 번째 goal = 목표(운동 목표)
det.analysis:
✅ ② 골(득점) — 목표: 축구에서의 골 vs 운동 목표
❌ ① 목표 — 목표: 첫 번째는 축구 골
❌ ③ 골(득점) — 골(득점): 두 번째는 운동 목표
❌ ④ 규칙 — 목표: goal에 '규칙'이란 뜻 없음
det.tip: goal: ① (스포츠) 골, 득점 ② 목표

questions.stem:
다음 영영풀이에 해당하는 단어로 가장 적절한 것은?

"a plan that lists events or activities and the times they will happen"

det.korean: 일정, 스케줄 — 이벤트나 활동의 시간을 나열한 계획
det.analysis:
✅ ③ schedule: 활동과 시간을 나열한 계획 → 일정
❌ ① diary: 일기 — 하루 기록
❌ ② mirror: 거울 — 사물
❌ ④ breakfast: 아침 식사 — 음식
det.tip: schedule = a plan listing events and times(일정)

questions.passage: Exploring a new world in class is wonderful! After lunch, I go outside to play soccer. I feel happy when my team wins! We both smile and cheer for each other.
questions.stem:
다음 문장에서 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꾸시오.

"(Explore) a new world in class is wonderful!"

det.korean: 동명사 주어: Exploring — 문장의 주어 자리에 동명사 사용
det.analysis: Explore → Exploring: 문장의 주어 역할을 하므로 동명사(-ing) 형태가 적절. 'Exploring a new world in class is wonderful!'
det.tip: 동명사 주어: -ing 형태가 문장의 주어 역할

questions.passage: "Do you know about Pharaohs? They were the kings of ancient Egypt. You can see their lives in these wall paintings. The ancient Egyptians believed in life after death."
questions.stem:
다음 문장에서 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꾸시오.

"The ancient Egyptians (believe) in life after death."

det.korean: 과거시제: believed — 고대 이집트인들의 과거 사실이므로 과거형
det.analysis: believe → believed: 고대 이집트인의 신앙을 설명하므로 과거시제(-ed) 사용. 'The ancient Egyptians believed in life after death.'
